## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Mahāyāna *sūtra* in question-and-answer form, translated by **Fǎ Hǎi** 法海 ([法海](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%B5%B7)) under the Liú-Sòng. The bodhisattva *Jìtiáoyīn* 寂調音 ("Quiet-Harmonious-Voice") inquires of the Buddha about points of bodhisattva-practice and discipline.

**Abstract**

The text belongs to the *bodhisattva-paripṛcchā* genre — Mahāyāna *sūtras* in which a named bodhisattva poses doctrinal-disciplinary questions to the Buddha. The bodhisattva *Jìtiáoyīn* is otherwise unattested, suggesting either a localised cult or a generic naming. The text's inclusion in the Vinaya division reflects its precept-content.
